get.description: Retrieves a list of leads which are members of the designated program. Required Permissions: Read-Only Lead, Read-Write Lead

parameters.name: programId
parameters.description: The id of the program to retrieve from

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to be returned for each record

parameters.name: batchSize
parameters.description: The batch size to return. The max and default value is 300.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: A token will be returned by this endpoint if the result set is greater than the batch size and can be passed in a subsequent call through this parameter. See Paging Tokens for more info.

code.description: Error code of the error. See full list of error codes here

message.description: Message describing the cause of the error

id.description: Unique integer id of a lead record

membership.description: Membership data for the parent program. Only returned via Get Leads By Program Id

reason.description: Reason object describing why an operation did not succeed for a record

status.description: Status of the operation performed on the record

Lead.description: Lead record. Always contains id, but may have any number of other fields, depending on the fields available in the target instance.

acquiredBy.description: Whether the lead was acquired by the parent program

isExhausted.description: Whether the lead is currently exhausted in the stream, if applicable

membershipDate.description: Date the lead first became a member of the program

nurtureCadence.description: Cadence of the parent stream if applicable

progressionStatus.description: Program status of the lead in the parent program

reachedSuccess.description: Whether the lead is in a success-status in the parent program

stream.description: Stream that the lead is a member of, if the parent program is an engagement program

message.description: Message describing the reason for the status of the operation

errors.description: Array of errors that occurred if the request was unsuccessful

moreResult.description: Boolean indicating if there are more results in subsequent pages

nextPageToken.description: Paging token given if the result set exceeded the allowed batch size

result.description: Array of results for individual records in the operation, may be empty

warnings.description: Array of warnings given for the operation
